items.prompt: A BUY call with K=100, premium 5, quantity 2 has terminal spot 110. What is the matching SELL-leg profit?

options.why: That is the BUY result: 2*(10-5), not the corresponding SELL result.
SELL is the negative of the corresponding BUY contribution.
That ignores the premium and uses intrinsic alone.
That also omits the premium received by the seller.

items.explanation: SELL is the negative of the corresponding BUY contribution.
